name: Google
summary: Your Google calendar, mail and contacts, read for you; anything sent asks first.

requires.why: To talk to Google: googleapis.com, oauth2.googleapis.com, accounts.google.com.
For one moment, on 127.0.0.1 only, so Google can hand back your sign-in.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.hint: From your own Desktop OAuth client in the Google Cloud console. The plugin's README walks you through making one; it is free.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.hint: Shown beside the client ID in the Google Cloud console. It is kept in this computer's keychain.

settings.label: Connect Google
settings.hint: Opens Google's sign-in page in your browser. Google warns that the app is unverified: it is your own client, so that is expected.

settings.label: Calendars
settings.hint: Which calendars to read, by calendar ID, separated by commas. "primary" is your main one. New events go in the first.

settings.label: Google sign-in
settings.hint: Written by the plugin when you connect. Kept in this computer's keychain.
